‍


### What’s New in September 2026


This month’s updates bring clearer project insights and more flexibility to audio labeling in Data Studio, alongside simpler setup options in LLM Labs. Together, they help you review work with greater context and adapt project workflows to your needs.


### Data Studio


#### Jev in ML-assisted Labeling: Add Fast, Cost-Effective, Reliable Model Support to Your Workflow


You can select Jev for your ML-assisted Labeling workflow as the pioneer of the decision model. To try it in your own project, contact **Datasaur Support** and we’ll help you get started.


#### Audio Labeling: Mark Audio Without Needing a Transcript


You can label specific segments directly in the audio, even when there’s no transcript to work from.
‍


#### Row Labeling Project Template: Start Projects Faster with a Ready-to-Use Template


A new built-in Row Labeling template gives you a ready-made starting point when creating a project.


#### Analytics Distribution Tab: See How Labels and Answers Are Distributed Across a Project


The Analytics Extension now gives you a Distribution tab with label and answer counts, including accepted and rejected items, so you can get a clearer picture of project results.


#### File Distribution: Keep Relevant Pre-Labels and Answers When Splitting Documents


In Span and Row projects, splitting documents with pre-labels into multiple parts preserves the pre-labels and row answers associated with each part, so existing work stays with the relevant data.


#### Audio Transcript Links: Create and Edit Transcript Links While Working with Audio


Create or update transcript links alongside the corresponding audio, without switching to the text viewer.


#### Connected Apps: Review and Revoke Third-Party Access You’ve Granted in One Place


The new “Connected apps” page in Account settings lets you review and revoke access you’ve personally granted to third-party apps.


### LLM Labs


#### Knowledge Base Processing Controls: Configure External Vector Store Processing Time Per Knowledge Base


You can now set the maximum document processing time for external vector stores on a per-knowledge-base basis through the API, rather than relying on one setting for the whole application.


#### Provider Credential Updates: Change Settings Without Re-entering Existing Configuration


When you edit a connected external provider’s credentials, its existing configuration is now preserved and prefilled, making it easier to update a setting without disconnecting and reconnecting the provider.


Stay tuned, more updates are on the way next month!
